# Manish Cinematic

> Bihar's trusted wedding photography, 4K cinematic wedding film, pre-wedding shoot, drone videography, and Instagram reel making studio based in Ayodhya Chowk, Teghra, Begusarai, Bihar, India (ManishCinematic.in).

Manish Cinematic serves families, couples, shops, and coaching centres across Begusarai, Teghra, Barauni, Samastipur, Khagaria, Lakhisarai, Mokama, Munger, Patna, Darbhanga, Muzaffarpur, Hajipur, Bhagalpur, Nalanda, Gaya, Purnia, and all of Bihar. Rating: 4.8/5.0 across 100+ events covered, 5 Lakh+ reel views, and 50+ happy families. Opening hours: Daily 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST.
